provenance.citation: Minsky, M. (1974). A Framework for Representing Knowledge. MIT AI Laboratory Memo 306. Reprinted in Winston (Ed.), The Psychology of Computer Vision, 1975.
provenance.locus: Sections on frame systems and default assignments: 'a frame's terminals are normally already filled with default assignments' inherited through more general frames unless overridden by specific evidence.
provenance.notes: my_chair isa chair isa furniture. chair carries the default legs=4; my_chair has no own legs slot, so resolution walks 2 frames (my_chair, chair) and returns the inherited default 4.
